purpose: Consolidate CPU-only evidence and independent_review reading for a possible post-legal40k relation-cue WWM route; no model training, no GPU work, no official evaluation result, and no route launch.

s66_t9_tool1 legal40k seed43122 full official evaluation

prefix_identity.interpretation: The 100M launch stream first 10M charged words are exactly a row-object multiset permutation of the audited 10M pool. The first rows are in different order, so partial prefix subsets need not match the standalone 10M sequence.

execution_replay_10k.interpretation: The partial 10k stream-order subset does not match the first 10k rows of the standalone 10M file, as expected for a permuted first pass. Its masking replay nevertheless verifies the enabled research path on real launch-order rows and actual train RNG seeds.

independent_review_summary.core_reading: The intervention is genuinely a target-selection/objective intervention if tokenizer, architecture, data stream, optimizer, seeds, and WWM curriculum are fixed. Boost 2.0 is the best-supported first elevated dose: no clipping, relation selected-group fraction about 0.219, relation target-token fraction about 0.195, and only about 1.35% expected target-token reduction. Main remaining confounds are cue frequency/predictability, source-dependent dose, lexicon precision/provenance, unpaired mask randomness, and inherited corruption policy allowing rare special-token random replacements.

route_implication: If the pending legal40k official vectors fail in relation/world-knowledge columns, relation-cue WWM boost 2.0 is better specified than it was at research and is a distinct learning-signal route, not another vocabulary sweep. It should still not be launched until legal40k vectors are read; if legal40k succeeds, protect/reproduce the compliant endpoint instead.
